platform_info.name: Instagram
platform_info.description: Note that supported DDP language also includes Dutch and probably other languages as well. You get an english DDP regardless of the Dutch language setting. These data donation flows have not been tested yet, if you find anything wrong with them report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

description.en: The core account details Instagram stores for your profile — name, username, contact details, and more — read from your export's personal_information.json file.
description.nl: De belangrijkste accountgegevens die Instagram voor je profiel bewaart — naam, gebruikersnaam, contactgegevens en meer — gelezen uit het bestand personal_information.json van je export.

documentation.summary: One row per account field Instagram stores for the participant's profile — username, name, contact details, and whatever else this file bundles.

columns.Field: Name of the account field (e.g. Username, Email address).
columns.Value: Value Instagram has on file for that field.

title.en: Categories advertisers used to target you
title.nl: Categorieën die adverteerders gebruikten om jou te bereiken

description.en: Targeting-segment labels Instagram's ad system has assigned to your account, read from your export's other_categories_used_to_reach_you.json file.
description.nl: Targeting-segmentlabels die het advertentiesysteem van Instagram aan je account heeft toegekend, gelezen uit het bestand other_categories_used_to_reach_you.json van je export.

title.en: Categories advertisers used to target you
title.nl: Categorieën die adverteerders gebruikten om jou te bereiken

documentation.summary: Each row is one inferred targeting-segment label Instagram's ad system has assigned to the participant's account.

title.nl: Websites die Instagram registreerde dat je bezocht

description.en: Websites you visited outside Instagram, recorded in your export's link_history.json file, including the full URL. These URLs sometimes carry tracking parameters (such as utm or fbclid codes) added by the platform.
description.nl: Websites die je buiten Instagram hebt bezocht, vastgelegd in het bestand link_history.json van je export, inclusief de volledige URL. Deze URL's bevatten soms trackingparameters (zoals utm- of fbclid-codes) die door het platform zijn toegevoegd.

title.nl: Websites die Instagram registreerde dat je bezocht

documentation.summary: Each row is one off-Instagram website visit Instagram logged for the participant, with the full URL and page title.

columns.Page title: Title of the visited web page.
columns.URL: Full URL of the visited web page, tracking parameters included when present.
columns.Visit start: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the visit started.
columns.Visit end: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the visit ended.

title.en: Advertisers using your activity or information
title.nl: Adverteerders die je activiteit of informatie gebruiken

description.en: Advertisers that uploaded or used a contact list matching your account, read from your export's advertisers_using_your_activity_or_information.json file.
description.nl: Adverteerders die een contactlijst hebben geüpload of gebruikt die overeenkomt met je account, gelezen uit het bestand advertisers_using_your_activity_or_information.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one advertiser that used the participant's activity or information to target them on Instagram.

columns.Category: Category describing how the advertiser used the participant's data.

title.en: When and where you logged in
title.nl: Wanneer en waar je bent ingelogd

description.en: Login events Instagram recorded for your account, including the IP address used, read from your export's login_activity.json file. An IP address is the network identifier a device is assigned when it connects to the internet.
description.nl: Login-gebeurtenissen die Instagram voor je account heeft geregistreerd, inclusief het gebruikte IP-adres, gelezen uit het bestand login_activity.json van je export. Een IP-adres is de netwerkidentificatie die een apparaat krijgt toegewezen wanneer het verbinding maakt met internet.

title.en: When and where you logged in
title.nl: Wanneer en waar je bent ingelogd

documentation.summary: Each row is one login Instagram recorded for the participant's account, with the IP address it was made from.

columns.IP address: IP address the login was made from.
columns.Language code: Language code the client reported at login time.

title.en: Places Instagram thinks you're interested in
title.nl: Plaatsen waarvan Instagram denkt dat je erin geïnteresseerd bent

description.en: Place names Instagram has inferred you're interested in, read from your export's locations_of_interest.json file.
description.nl: Plaatsnamen waarvan Instagram heeft afgeleid dat je erin geïnteresseerd bent, gelezen uit het bestand locations_of_interest.json van je export.

title.en: Places Instagram thinks you're interested in
title.nl: Plaatsen waarvan Instagram denkt dat je erin geïnteresseerd bent

documentation.summary: Each row is one place name Instagram has inferred the participant is interested in.

columns.Location: One inferred place of interest (typically a city/region pair).

title.nl: Je trackinginstellingen voor activiteit buiten Instagram

description.en: Settings and counters for whether Instagram links your activity to other Meta apps and websites, read from your export's your_activity_off_meta_technologies_settings.json file.
description.nl: Instellingen en tellers die aangeven of Instagram je activiteit koppelt aan andere Meta-apps en -websites, gelezen uit het bestand your_activity_off_meta_technologies_settings.json van je export.

documentation.summary: One row per off-Meta activity tracking setting or counter Instagram keeps for the participant's account.

columns.Label: Name of the setting or counter.

title.nl: Waar Instagram denkt dat je woont

description.en: The country, region, and city Instagram has inferred as your base, read from your export's profile_based_in.json file.
description.nl: Het land, de regio en de stad die Instagram als jouw thuisbasis heeft afgeleid, gelezen uit het bestand profile_based_in.json van je export.

documentation.summary: The country, region, and city Instagram has inferred as the participant's base.

columns.Field: Name of the inferred field (Country, Region, or City).

title.en: The camera and device Instagram has detected
title.nl: De camera en het apparaat die Instagram heeft gedetecteerd

description.en: A device and camera fingerprint Instagram has recorded for your account, read from your export's camera_information.json file.
description.nl: Een apparaat- en cameravingerafdruk die Instagram voor je account heeft geregistreerd, gelezen uit het bestand camera_information.json van je export.

documentation.summary: A device and camera fingerprint (device ID, supported camera SDK versions) Instagram has recorded for the participant.

description.en: Accounts that follow you on Instagram, read from your export's followers_1.json file.
description.nl: Accounts die je op Instagram volgen, gelezen uit het bestand followers_1.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one account that follows the participant on Instagram, including when they started following.

columns.Account: Username or display name of the follower account.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the follower's Instagram profile.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the account started following the participant.

description.en: Accounts you follow on Instagram, read from your export's following.json file.
description.nl: Accounts die je op Instagram volgt, gelezen uit het bestand following.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one account that the participant follows on Instagram, including when they started following.

columns.Account: Username or display name of the followed account.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the followed account's Instagram profile.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the participant started following this account.

description.en: Posts that appeared in your Instagram feed and were registered as viewed, read from your export's posts_viewed.json file.
description.nl: Berichten die in je Instagram-feed verschenen en als bekeken zijn geregistreerd, gelezen uit het bestand posts_viewed.json van je export.

title.en: The total number of Instagram posts you viewed over time
title.nl: Het totale aantal Instagram-berichten dat je in de loop van de tijd hebt bekeken

title.en: The total number of Instagram posts you have viewed per hour of the day
title.nl: Het totale aantal Instagram-berichten dat je per uur van de dag hebt bekeken

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post that appeared in the participant's Instagram feed and was registered as viewed. Captures the author and timing of each impression.

columns.Author: Username or display name of the account that published the viewed post.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the viewed post.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was viewed.

description.en: Videos, including Reels, that you watched on Instagram, read from your export's videos_watched.json file.
description.nl: Video's, inclusief Reels, die je op Instagram hebt bekeken, gelezen uit het bestand videos_watched.json van je export.

title.en: The total number of videos watched on Instagram over time
title.nl: Het totale aantal video's dat je op Instagram hebt bekeken in de loop van de tijd

documentation.summary: Each row represents one video (including Reels) that the participant watched on Instagram. Captures the creator and timing of each view event.

columns.Author: Username or display name of the account that published the watched video.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the watched video.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the video was watched.

description.en: Posts you liked on Instagram, read from your export's liked_posts.json file.
description.nl: Berichten die je leuk vond op Instagram, gelezen uit het bestand liked_posts.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post the participant liked on Instagram, including the account whose post was liked and when the like was given.

columns.Account name: Username of the account whose post was liked.
columns.Value: Display name or additional label for the liked post, depending on export format.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was liked.

description.en: Comments you posted on Instagram posts, read from your export's post_comments*.json files.
description.nl: Reacties die je op Instagram-berichten hebt geplaatst, gelezen uit de post_comments*.json-bestanden van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one comment the participant posted on an Instagram post. Covers all matching comment files in the archive (e.g. post_comments.json, post_comments_1.json).

columns.Comment: The full text of the comment posted by the participant.
columns.Media owner: Username of the account that owns the post the comment was placed on.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was posted.

description.en: Comments by others that you liked on Instagram, read from your export's liked_comments.json file.
description.nl: Reacties van anderen die je leuk vond op Instagram, gelezen uit het bestand liked_comments.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one comment the participant liked on Instagram. Comment text may be absent in newer export formats.

columns.Account name: Username of the account whose comment was liked.
columns.Value: Text of the liked comment, if available in the export (empty in newer export formats).
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was liked.

description.en: Posts you bookmarked on Instagram, read from your export's saved_posts.json file.
description.nl: Berichten die je op Instagram hebt opgeslagen, gelezen uit het bestand saved_posts.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post the participant bookmarked (saved) on Instagram for later viewing.

columns.Caption: Caption text of the saved post.
columns.URL: URL linking to the saved post.
columns.Username: Username of the account that created the saved post.
columns.Hashtags: Space-separated hashtags associated with the saved post, or 'Geen hashtags' if none.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was saved.

description.en: Stories you published on Instagram, read from your export's stories.json file.
description.nl: Stories die je op Instagram hebt geplaatst, gelezen uit het bestand stories.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one Instagram Story published by the participant.

columns.Text: Caption or text of the story, or 'Story has no text' when empty.
columns.Media type: File extension of the story media asset (e.g. .jpg, .mp4).
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the story was created.

description.en: Posts you published on Instagram, read from your export's posts_*.json files.
description.nl: Berichten die je op Instagram hebt geplaatst, gelezen uit de posts_*.json-bestanden van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post published by the participant on Instagram.

columns.Title: Caption or title text of the post.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was created.

description.en: Words or phrases you searched for on Instagram, read from your export's word_or_phrase_searches.json file.
description.nl: Woorden of zinnen waarnaar je op Instagram hebt gezocht, gelezen uit het bestand word_or_phrase_searches.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one keyword or phrase search the participant performed on Instagram.

columns.Search term: The word or phrase that was searched for.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the search was performed.

description.en: Profiles you searched for on Instagram, read from your export's profile_searches.json file.
description.nl: Profielen waarnaar je op Instagram hebt gezocht, gelezen uit het bestand profile_searches.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one profile search performed by the participant on Instagram, recording what was searched and when.

columns.Name: Username or display name that was searched for.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the search was performed.

description.en: Threads posts you viewed, read from your export's threads_viewed.json file.
description.nl: Threads-berichten die je hebt bekeken, gelezen uit het bestand threads_viewed.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post on Threads (Meta's text-based social network linked to Instagram) that the participant viewed, including the author and timing.

columns.Author: Username or display name of the account that published the viewed Threads post.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the viewed Threads post.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was viewed.

description.en: Advertisements shown to you on Instagram, read from your export's ads_viewed.json file.
description.nl: Advertenties die op Instagram aan je zijn getoond, gelezen uit het bestand ads_viewed.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one advertisement impression shown to the participant on Instagram. Includes the advertiser identity and when the ad was displayed.

columns.Account name: Username of the advertiser's Instagram account.
columns.Name: Display name of the advertiser.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the ad was shown to the participant.

description.en: Advertisements you clicked on Instagram, read from your export's ads_clicked.json file.
description.nl: Advertenties waarop je op Instagram hebt geklikt, gelezen uit het bestand ads_clicked.json van je export.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one advertisement the participant clicked on Instagram.

columns.Action: The action performed on the ad (e.g. Click).
columns.Title: Title or name of the clicked advertisement.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the ad was clicked.
